admission.justification: Binds the review surface to the three served views: a retired view stays retired on every path, including paging and task context.

alternatives.option: review_matrix and curation_queue views, the records page/cursor and MatrixSelection are gone; the removed collection earns comparison_page_unreadable with no channel row.
alternatives.reason: Views that read the retired envelope tables cannot be served; a measured zero would claim a walk that never happened.

alternatives.option: Keep serving review_matrix/curation_queue views and the records page over the envelope tables.
alternatives.reason: There are no envelope tables; the views would read nothing and the page would walk no collection.
alternatives.reconsider_when: A governed collection with a real owner needs a served walk.

consequences: Re-adding a records walk requires a governed collection with a real owner, not a revived cursor over a removed view.
context: MIK-R74 rule 1 retires the matrix/queue surfaces; bounded pagination, the knowledge pane and the task-context composition all carry the refusal instead of a page.
